title: ジャパンカップの後に・執事なき激戦

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Oguri Cap's invitation, Tamamo Cross enters the Japan Cup—the second of the three big G1 races this season—and emerges victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, with her body buckling under the stress, it was definitely a narrow victory. Hoping her condition will improve, we head for the Arima Kinen.
